summary: From farm to café: the companies KIRA found at each stage of the Vietnamese coffee chain. Bubble size is the number of companies in KIRA's database, or an official estimate where one exists.
method: Every company links to the page where we found it. All entries come from desk research and have not been verified by an analyst; "confidence" reflects how directly the source supports the stage and role, not company quality.
Counts are companies KIRA found, not the whole market. Smallholder farmers, small dealers and independent cafés are mostly absent because they have no findable legal entity.

Ring colour needs a sourced concentration figure. Almost no company has a sourced capital figure yet, so rings use stage-level shares from industry statistics where they exist (export, retail) and stay grey elsewhere.
Tax IDs and registered capital are mostly empty: the registry lookup (MST) step is not built into this prototype.
